title: feat(plugin-auth): a sign-in that skips the OIDC seams applies the IdP locale rule through AuthManager.applyIdpLocaleClaim
body:
domain:spec#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzgrxXwu9nECtirwHEK

<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBBw7sfgcdYpSr4xrGUrivAR)_

Fixes #27334

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` teaches the IdP locale claim, `IdpLocaleSync` or `sys_user.locale` sync (`git grep -n -i "idp.\?locale\|locale claim" -- skills` answers 0 lines on HEAD); the change is a new method on an exported class and one new type export, with no metadata key or value.

Consumer: objectstack-ai/cloud#3159 (the cloud sso-exchange door wires the call; the cloud half stays there).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`@objectstack/plugin-auth` 的 `AuthManager` 新增公开方法 `applyIdpLocaleClaim(userId, claim)`，入口再导出 `IdpLocaleClaim` 类型。它调用的就是 OIDC 登录本来就在用的那段规则（`IdpLocaleSync.apply`，从 `settle` 里拆出来），规则只有一份。
- 为什么改：cloud 控制台的「打开」走 sso-open → sso-exchange 交接，不经过 OIDC，所以拿不到「语言跟随 cloud 账号」的规则；包入口此前没导出任何可调用的东西（cloud#3159 实测）。
- 风险与回滚：只是加宽公开面，规则、`idp-locale:` 记录标识和 OIDC 路径行为都没变（OIDC 端到端用例原样全绿，另有 spy 钉住 OIDC 走同一方法）。方法从不抛错。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/idp-locale-claim.ts`（`settle` / `apply` 的拆分），`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts`（`applyIdpLocaleClaim`），`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts`（类型导出）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/idp-locale-claim.test.ts`，应 28/28 全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地（落地前须有契约复审记录）。

## What changes

### Measured first, on `origin/main` `efa2915e`

- **What the entry exports today.** `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/index.ts` lists auth-manager's published names by name (`DEFAULT_AUTH_BASE_PATH`, `readMcpServerEnabledEnv`, `resolveOidcProviderEnabled`, `resolveDcrEnabled`, `resolveScimEnabled`, `assertScimAdminCoherence`, `isOAuthEligibleBaseUrl`, `InvitationPlacementServiceLike`, `readInvitationPlacementIntent`, `AuthManagerOptions`, `ipMatchesRange`, `normalizeAuthEmailLocale`, `authEmailLocaleFromRequest`, `AuthManager`) and carries 31 `export * from` lines for its other modules. `idp-locale-claim.ts` is not among them: `grep -c "idp-locale-claim" src/index.ts` answers 0, and the built `dist/index.d.ts` names none of `IdpLocaleSync`, `readIdpLocaleClaim`, `resolveIdpLocale`, `decideIdpLocaleWrite`, `idpLocaleRecordIdentifier`, `IdpLocaleClaim`. The card's premise holds.
- **`settle`'s apply half** (`idp-locale-claim.ts` on `efa2915e`): after taking the staged claim off the endpoint context and checking the session's `userId`, it ran, inside one `try`: the supported-locale guard (no locales ⇒ one `warn`, nothing written), `getEngine()`, `authContextOf(ctx) ?? resolveAuth()`, the `sys_user.locale` read, the `idp-locale:USERID` record read through better-auth's database adapter, `decideIdpLocaleWrite(...)`, the column write, `replaceIdpLocaleRecord(...)`, and the never-throw `warn` in the `catch`.
- **How code outside the package reaches the running auth manager.** `AuthPlugin` registers the `AuthManager` instance itself as the kernel service `auth` (`auth-plugin.ts:776`, `ctx.registerService('auth', this.authManager)`); hosts read it with `ctx.getService('auth')` (`packages/runtime/src/dispatcher-plugin.ts:2453`, `packages/cloud-connection/src/cloud-connection-plugin.ts:470`), and this package's own tests take it as `kernel.getService('auth')` typed as `AuthManager`. `AuthManager` is already an entry export. The `IdpLocaleSync` the OIDC path uses is a private field of that instance, wired to the manager's data engine, the i18n service's locales and better-auth's auth context.

### The change

- **`IdpLocaleSync.apply(userId, claim, ctx?)`** (new, public) holds the apply half above, moved verbatim. `settle` now takes the staged claim and the session's `userId` exactly as before, then calls `apply(userId, claim, ctx)`. The only added lines in `apply` are its own input guard (`userId` a non-empty string and a claim present, else return), so a JavaScript caller cannot make it throw before the `try`.
- **`AuthManager.applyIdpLocaleClaim(userId, claim)`** (new, public) returns `this.idpLocale.apply(userId, claim)`. It is the accessor the order prefers: the caller reaches it on the instance the kernel already exposes, and no second `IdpLocaleSync` is constructed, so the once-only "no i18n service" warning, the engine, the locale list and the auth store are the manager's own. Without an endpoint context the auth store resolves through the manager's `linkingContext()` (the same fallback the OIDC path uses when a call carries no context).
- **Entry export: `type IdpLocaleClaim`** from `idp-locale-claim.js`, the argument the method takes (`{ providerId?, value }`).
- Each published name carries a docblock with the rule in one sentence (written while `sys_user.locale` is unset or still the value an IdP sign-in last wrote; a local choice is kept) and says it never throws.

### Exported names, and why each

| Name | Exported | Why |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `AuthManager.applyIdpLocaleClaim` | yes (a method of the already-exported class) | The one call cloud#3159 needs: the user id it signs in and the cloud account's language. |
| `IdpLocaleClaim` | yes (type only) | The method's argument type; a TypeScript caller names it. |
| `IdpLocaleSync` | no | The caller reaches its `apply` through the manager; exporting the class invites a second instance with its own deps. |
| `readIdpLocaleClaim` | no | It reads a better-auth `validateUserInfo` source (`method` + `oauth`/`sso` profile); the sso-exchange door holds a cloud account, not that shape, and passes `{ providerId, value }` directly. |
| `resolveIdpLocale`, `decideIdpLocaleWrite`, `idpLocaleRecordIdentifier` | no | Internal steps of the rule; the method applies them. Publishing them would let a caller rebuild the rule beside it, which is the second owner the ruling forbids. |

No change to the rule, to the record identifier (`idp-locale:USERID`), or to the OIDC path's observable behaviour: the end-of-chain OIDC cases in `idp-locale-claim.test.ts` are untouched and green.

### Changeset level: `patch`, not the order's `minor`

The order asked for a `minor` changeset. AGENTS.md (Post-Task Checklist step 3) grades the level by the `Metadata-protocol:` kind alone: "a kind takes at least `minor` on a package the diff moves, `none` takes `patch`; a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch`". This change is `Metadata-protocol: none`, so the changeset is `'@objectstack/plugin-auth': patch`, and `check:changeset-no-major` reads it so (Verification). Raised with the seat as a conflict between the order and AGENTS.md.

### Generated ledgers

None to regenerate. `@objectstack/plugin-auth` keeps no api-surface snapshot (the `api-surface/` ledger is `packages/spec`'s), and `git grep -l "authEmailLocaleFromRequest"` outside the package's `src/` finds only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/identity-auth.json`, a hand-kept test checklist, not an export ledger.

## Tests

- **The package entry.** `idp-locale-claim.test.ts` imports `./index` (the module tsup builds as the package entry, `dist/index.*`) and runs the three rule cases through `entry.AuthManager#applyIdpLocaleClaim` over the file's in-memory `IDataEngine` (already a pinned double; no new double) and the real better-auth database adapter the manager resolves: unset ⇒ `zh-CN` written with the `idp-locale:` record; still the recorded value ⇒ `en-US` overwrites both (stored `en`); a local `ja-JP` ⇒ kept, `engine.update` never called and the `sys_verification` rows byte-identical. A fourth case shows it never throws (a refusing user store, an empty user id, no claim: all resolve, one `warn`).
- **One method.** A spy on `IdpLocaleSync.prototype.apply` pins that a real OAuth sign-in through the platform IdP settles through it (called once with the user id, `{ providerId, value: 'zh-CN' }` and the endpoint context), and that `applyIdpLocaleClaim` calls the same method.
- **The package entry is imported as `./index`, not as `@objectstack/plugin-auth`.** The package cannot import its own name in vitest without a new self-alias in `vitest.config.ts`, which is outside the declared file surface; `./index` is the same module the published entry is built from.

## Acceptance notes

- `applyIdpLocaleClaim` is a method of `AuthManager`, not of the `IAuthService` contract in `packages/spec`: adding it there would move `packages/spec`, outside the declared file surface. A host that types the `auth` service as `IAuthService` casts to `AuthManager` to reach it, as this package's own tests do.
- The method runs with no endpoint context, so the auth store is resolved from the auth instance (`linkingContext()`); a host that calls it before the auth instance is built triggers that build, as any other `AuthManager` call that needs the auth context does.

## Verification

All readings on head `fd9a0e60` (branch base `efa2915e`; `origin/main` has since moved to `9d5ebfde` with no commit under `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`, so no merge was taken before opening).
